benefits_features_and_faqs.about_overview: AU Zenith+ Credit Card is a premium metal card that caters to the needs of frequent travellers as well as rewards high-spenders. A competitive addition to the list of premium cards, such as SBI Card Elite and HDFC Regalia Gold, this card offers benefits across multiple categories, like international travel, movies, golf, dining and others. Additional benefits, including complimentary airport lounge access and low forex mark-up fee further add to the card’s value.
highlights: Option to choose between a range of luxury brand vouchers or reward points worth Rs. 5,000 on card activation
2X Rewards: 2 Reward Points on every Rs. 100 spent on dining, travel, and international spends
1X Rewards: 1 Reward Point on every Rs. 100 spent on other spending categories
milestone_benefits: Option to choose between a range of luxury brand vouchers or reward points worth Rs. 5,000 on card activation
2X Rewards: 2 Reward Points on every Rs. 100 spent on dining, travel, and international spends

dining_benefits: 2X Rewards: 2 Reward Points on every Rs. 100 spent on dining, travel, and international spends
movie_benefits: Free movie/ event tickets worth up to Rs. 8,000 every year

golf_summary.extra_notes: Includes 8 complimentary golf games or coaching sessions/yr

insurance_cover: Capping: Capping of 1,000 reward points on utility & telecom, insurance, education, government and rental spends.
| Air Accident Cover | Up to Rs. 2 crore |
| Card Liability Cover | Up to Rs. 15 lakhs |
| Credit Shield | Up to Rs. 15 lakhs |

In addition to the above-mentioned covers, cardholders can also avail device protection plan for electronics purchased via the card and other travel-related covers for baggage delay, light delay, loss of passport, and plane hijack.
concierge_or_privilege: 4 complimentary airport meet & assist concierge services with end-to-end airport VIP check-in per year, max. 1 per quarter
get_this_card_if: You frequently travel within and outside the country and want a card with low forex mark-up fee
You are a high-spender, do not mind paying a high annual fee and can maximise savings by availing the milestone benefits
You frequently make movie ticket bookings through BookMyShow
You prefer to earn reward points on your spends, instead of direct cashback

faqs.q: How do I avail concierge services using AU Zenith+ Credit Card?
faqs.a: You can avail the concierge service on AU Zenith+ Credit Card by calling the concierge desk on 1800 210 0298 (toll-free) or 022-42320298.

faqs.q: What are the benefits offered on international spends by AU Zenith+ Credit Card?
faqs.a: You can earn 2 reward points on every Rs. 100 spent and get a comparatively lower forex mark-up of 0.99% on international spends made by AU Zenith+ Credit Card.

faqs.q: Which spends are excluded from the rewards program of AU Zenith+ Credit Card?
faqs.a: Spending categories like cash withdrawal, fuel and EMI transactions are excluded from reward benefits of AU Zenith+ Credit Card.

faqs.q: What is the discount capping on movie tickets booked on BookMyShow by AU Zenith+ Credit Card?
faqs.a: You can get a discount of up to Rs. 500 per ticket on BookMyShow via AU Zenith+ Credit Card.
